**Severity:** warning · **Area:** Resume (`RV2xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
{framework} island {id} recovered from an error: {message}
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Make the island render the same markup on the server and in the browser: no `typeof window` / `Date.now()` / `Math.random()` / locale-dependent output during render — move browser-only values into an effect, or make the island `client="only"`.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
// Clock.react.tsx
export function Clock() { return <time>{new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}</time>; }
```

```tsx prefer
// Clock.react.tsx
export function Clock() {
  const [now, setNow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => setNow(new Date().toLocaleTimeString()), []);
  return <time>{now ?? ""}</time>;
}
```

## When it is reported

Browser (framework adapter). The framework threw away the server HTML of the island and rendered it on the client (React `onRecoverableError`): the page works, but the island paid a full client render and lost the server markup. Dev: an entry on the dev error channel (overlay / devtools log) naming the island; production: `console.error` with the code. Rivet slot content inside the island is kept (same nodes).
